_comment: The FROZEN parameters and nothing else — PROTOCOL.md §4. Fill in, rename to protocol.json, commit and git-tag it. Operational settings (drand endpoint, Pantheon base URLs, timeouts) belong in runtime.json and are deliberately not frozen; putting one of them here is rejected at startup. chain_hash and chain_public_key are the real drand quicknet values as of 2026-09-09, verified against https://api.drand.sh/<chain_hash>/info — re-confirm both at freeze time. Use tools/pick-round.js --in 72h --write to set target_round, target_round_utc, submission_cutoff_utc, submission_opens_utc and reveal_gap_seconds together, so they cannot disagree. submission_opens_utc is stamped with the moment the round was chosen, which is the moment the window opened; it is what lets the waiting page draw its timeline to real scale, and it steers nothing. schedule_template_ref and generate_script_ref name the freeze tag; leave the <tag> placeholder alone, because tools/freeze.js --tag writes your real tag name into both. reveal_gap_seconds is the interval between submissions closing and the beacon that opens them; it is what gives anyone a moment to publish the roll of who submitted while it is still impossible to know which late submission would be useful (PROTOCOL.md section 9). final_round freezes the twelfth round (PROTOCOL.md §11): whether there is one, that ranks 1-4 sit at table one, and that the winds are drawn by taking the seatings which complete the most players to three of every wind and picking uniformly among them. The final beacon is NOT here — it is chosen weeks later, at lock time, and lives in events/final/lock.json. Which column the standings are ranked on is not here either; that is runtime.json → pantheon.rating_order_by.
